The Cornucopias Land Utility Deck

We’re incredibly excited to bring you some BRAND NEW details on utilities for our Land Plot NFTs!

Land ownership is at the center of the Cornucopias economy which is why we've designed utilities around XP systems, seasonal rewards, and in-game cosmetics. At the core of this framework is fairness and competitive integrity for an optimal gaming experience. Landowners have exclusive access to different earning opportunities to incentivize consistent contribution to the Cornucopias economy for a better gameplay experience for everyone!

Read here: https://links.cornucopias.io/land-plot-utility-rewards
